summary: Iteration 41: UX Polish Batch Testing Complete. All 11 UX improvements verified working correctly. Backend cache warm-up confirmed (6/6 tests passed). Frontend features all functional: Footer with 4 columns, Scroll-to-top button, Ctrl+K shortcut, Sector heatmap with skeleton loading, Watchlist empty state, Strategy Marketplace, Open Graph meta tags, favicon, CSS animations, Sonner toaster, and ErrorBoundary.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (lines 203-231): Cache warm-up implemented correctly with asyncio.create_task for non-blocking startup. Warms sector_heatmap, world_events, and foreign_markets caches.
Footer.jsx (83 lines): Clean 4-column footer with Brand, Platform, Resources, Legal sections. Uses scrollIntoView for navigation links. Has data-testid='app-footer'.
ScrollToTop.jsx (28 lines): Appears after 600px scroll, smooth scroll to top on click. Has data-testid='scroll-to-top-btn'.
Navbar.jsx: Ctrl+K/Cmd+K keyboard shortcut implemented with useEffect listener. Search input has kbd hint badge showing ⌘K.
ErrorBoundary.jsx (48 lines): Class component with getDerivedStateFromError and componentDidCatch. Shows crash recovery UI with reload button.
SectorHeatmap.jsx: Skeleton loading state with data-testid='sector-heatmap-skeleton' shows before data loads. 11 sector tiles render correctly.
Watchlist.jsx: Empty state with icon, 'No tickers yet' title, and descriptive text. Has data-testid='watchlist-empty'.
StrategyMarketplace.jsx: Empty state with data-testid='marketplace-empty' (currently has 5 strategies so list shows instead).
sonner.jsx: Fixed dark theme without next-themes dependency. Uses slate-800 background with proper styling.
index.html: OG tags (og:title, og:description, og:image), twitter:card, favicon.ico reference all present.
index.css: .animate-enter with fadeSlideUp animation, .animate-enter-d1 through d4 for staggered delays, .skeleton with shimmer animation, .scroll-fab transition.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 UX polish features from this batch are working: (1) Cache warm-up on startup for sector_heatmap, world_events, foreign_markets, (2) Footer with 4 columns and scroll-to-section links, (3) Scroll-to-top FAB appears after 600px scroll, (4) Ctrl+K focuses search input with kbd hint badge, (5) ErrorBoundary wraps entire app, (6) Sonner Toaster for toast notifications (dark theme), (7) SectorHeatmap skeleton loading, (8) Watchlist empty state with icon and text, (9) StrategyMarketplace empty state (currently has 5 strategies), (10) OG meta tags and twitter card, (11) favicon.ico, (12) CSS animations (.animate-enter, .skeleton). The app uses deep navy #0F172A theme - this is intentional design.
